subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should maintainers accept or sponsor a source-tested Feishu card JSON detection fix without live Feishu credentials, or keep this blocked until live Feishu proof is supplied?
rationale: Multiple narrow candidate fixes reached the same implementation shape but closed unmerged because the live Feishu proof gate could not be satisfied; automation should not open another fix PR until that proof policy choice is settled.

options.title: Sponsor proof override or maintainer live proof
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access or authority over the proof gate adopts a known candidate shape and supplies live proof or applies an explicit proof override before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a reporter or contributor can run a patched branch against a real Feishu workspace and post redacted evidence.

options.title: Reopen a candidate branch for review only
options.body: Reopen a closed candidate PR to preserve discussion, but still require the proof decision before merge.

recommendation.title: Sponsor proof override or maintainer live proof
recommendation.body: A maintainer with Feishu access or authority over the proof gate adopts a known candidate shape and supplies live proof or applies an explicit proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the merged Feishu payload path and prior maintainer repair note on the same candidate fix area.
